citations.title: IDF: Mahmoud Abd al-Fattah Awad eliminated after holding seven hostages
citations.excerpt: ELIMINATED: Mahmoud Abd al-Fattah Awad, a commander in Hamas military wing, who took part in holding 7 Israelis hostage. Among the hostages: Daniella Gilboa, Karina Ariev, Doron Steinbrecher, Naama Levy, Ziv Berman, Omri Miran and Eitan Mor in an underground tunnel in the Gaza City area. Recently the terrorist planned and advanced terror attacks against Israeli civilians and IDF troops and operated to restore Hamas capabilities, in systematic violation of the ceasefire. The terrorist was eliminated in order to remove the threat he posed.

He directed the transfer of 1 billion+ NIS in order to fund Hamas terrorist activities, making him a key figure in maintaining Hamas rule and survival. citations.title: IDF kills Hamas commander who had held seven Israeli hostages in Gaza tunnel
citations.excerpt: The Israel Defense Forces said on Thursday that it had eliminated Mahmoud Abd al-Fattah Awad, a Hamas commander who, according to the military, held seven hostages in a Gaza tunnel during the war. Awad, who was killed in an airstrike in the Gaza City area over the weekend, took part in holding hostages Daniella Gilboa, Karina Ariev, Doron Steinbrecher, Naama Levy, Ziv Berman, Omri Miran and Eitan Mor, according to the military. Awad had recently planned terror attacks against Israeli soldiers and civilians, and also worked to rebuild Hamas capabilities in systematic violation of the ceasefire, the IDF said. Prior to the strike, steps were taken to mitigate harm to civilians, including the use of precise munitions and aerial surveillance. IDF troops under the Southern Command remain deployed in the area in accordance with the agreement and will continue to operate to remove any immediate threat. Netanyahu and Katz said we will continue to hunt down Hamas commanders and operatives, target its sources of funding and destroy its terrorist infrastructure, and will not allow Hamas to rebuild its strength.

citations.title: Israel 81st session General Debate Netanyahu remarks
citations.excerpt: Benjamin Netanyahu, Prime Minister of Israel, said: If there are any other moral cowards who have not yet left this hall, please do so now, as several delegates walked out when he took the stage. I salute the courage of people of Israel and the most moral army in the world, the IDF, he said. What genocidal regime gives a million polio vaccinations to the enemy population? he asked, adding that Israel uses phone calls, text messages and leaflets to alert Palestinians before attacks. This is the opposite of genocide, he said. The simple truth is, he said: Israel did not commit genocide. Israel prevented genocide. What genocidal regime enables the distribution of two million tons of food into Gaza? That is a ton for every person.

citations.title: Netanyahu tells UN summit Israel will continue to win
citations.excerpt: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu delivered a defiant speech to a largely empty U.N. General Assembly Thursday, dismissing accusations of genocide against the Palestinians and vowing that Israel will continue to win against those who seek its destruction. Most of the delegates in the U.N. chamber got up and walked out as Mr. Netanyahu took his place. He rejected charges of Israeli colonialism. The Israeli prime minister also repudiated charges of genocide against Palestinians during the war in Gaza as the greatest lie of the century. What genocidal regime gives a million polio vaccinations to the enemy population? What genocidal regime enables the distribution of two million tons of food into Gaza? Mr. Netanyahu said.

citations.title: Israel policies threaten very existence of Palestinians, Abbas tells UN
citations.excerpt: Palestinian Authority President Mahmoud Abbas has warned the United Nations General Assembly that Israel policies go beyond undermining a two-state solution and now threaten the very life and existence of Palestinians. Abbas prerecorded remarks from his office in Ramallah were broadcast before the assembly on Thursday after the United States denied visas to a Palestinian delegation. Abbas said Palestinians were living through one of the most dangerous periods of their history, citing killing, destruction, starvation, attempts at displacement, as well as a genocidal war that has created an unprecedented humanitarian catastrophe. He called Israeli activities in the occupied West Bank a malicious colonial plan.

citations.title: Abbas at the United Nations: Palestinian people will not disappear
citations.excerpt: Palestinians are in danger of being pushed off their land as Israel closes off the option of a two-state solution, Palestinian Authority President Mahmoud Abbas told the United Nations General Assembly on Thursday in a virtual address. It has now come to threaten the very life and existence of the Palestinian people on their homeland. Israel Ambassador to the United Nations Danny Danon posted after the speech: Abu Mazen as long as you are funding terror, you will keep sending videos. Abbas echoed other world leaders in condemning Israel for its military actions in Gaza over the last three years in which 70,000 Palestinian militants and civilians were killed, calling it a war of genocide.

citations.title: MFA: While Abbas defames Israel at the UN, Israelis face Palestinian terror
citations.excerpt: While Mahmoud Abbas defames Israel at the UN, Israelis face a sustained wave of Palestinian terror attacks. Palestinian terrorists are shooting, stabbing and targeting Israelis - while Abbas and the PA continue to incite and glorify violence. Mahmoud Abbas preaches to the UN, but incites Palestinian terrorism through Pay-for-Slay. The Palestinian Authority is paying hundreds of millions of dollars a year to terrorists and their families. The more blood spilled - the greater the reward. Mahmoud Abbas rewards and encourages terror. You cannot incite hate and terror amongst children and then pretend you want peace.

citations.title: Al Jazeera: Israel carried out multiple attacks in Gaza, six people killed
citations.excerpt: Israel carried out multiple attacks in Gaza, at least six people have been killed. Israel continues to carry out near-daily strikes across Gaza in violation of a ceasefire agreement signed nearly a year ago. Al Jazeera Ibrahim al-Khalili reports. The network presented the strikes as an Israeli breach of the ceasefire rather than as operations against named Hamas commanders who the IDF said were restoring capabilities. Separate Al Jazeera coverage of the UN week framed Netanyahu General Assembly appearance against what it called a genocidal war in Gaza.

passages.text: The Israel-local monitoring window was dominated by the UN General Assembly clash: Mahmoud Abbas accused Israel of a genocidal war and a malicious colonial plan, while Benjamin Netanyahu told a hall thinned by walkouts that accusing Israel of genocide is the greatest lie of the century.

In Gaza the same day the IDF published two named elimination notices for Mahmoud Abd al-Fattah Awad, described as a hostage-holder of seven Israelis, and Muhammad Abu Alwan, described as Hamas finance chief who moved 1 billion+ NIS, and presented both as systematic ceasefire violations.

The IDF said Awad took part in holding Daniella Gilboa, Karina Ariev, Doron Steinbrecher, Naama Levy, Ziv Berman, Omri Miran and Eitan Mor in a Gaza City-area tunnel and was struck after planning new attacks. NY Post added that precise munitions and aerial surveillance were used.

Netanyahu and Katz said Israel will hunt Hamas commanders, funding and infrastructure and will not allow Hamas to rebuild its strength. The IDF said Abu Alwan directed 1 billion+ NIS and was restoring capabilities in systematic violation of the ceasefire.

Netanyahu official line at the UN was that Israel did not commit genocide and instead prevented it, pointing to a million polio vaccinations, two million tons of food into Gaza, and pre-strike warnings by phone, text and leaflet.

The Foreign Ministry answered Abbas in real time: Israelis face shooting and stabbing attacks while the PA pays hundreds of millions of dollars a year to terrorists and their families. Danny Danon said that as long as Abbas funds terror he will keep sending videos.
Abbas used the UN platform to describe Israeli policy as a threat to Palestinian existence. Al Jazeera led with that warning, and many delegates walked out of Netanyahu later speech.

Watch whether the systematic violation of the ceasefire formula becomes the standing Israeli legal frame for named strikes, and whether the genocide label on X keeps collapsing those strikes into a single UN-week verdict.

passages.text: The day highest-status anti-Israel claim at the UN was Mahmoud Abbas prerecorded assertion that Israeli policy now threatens the very life and existence of Palestinians and that Gaza is a genocidal war. Al Jazeera put that sentence in the headline.

Netanyahu reply was numerical: a million polio vaccinations, two million tons of food, and the line that Israel prevented genocide. The MFA added Pay-for-Slay. Those facts travel less far on X than the one-word verdict attached to his presence in the hall.

Al Jazeera English separately told its audience that Israel carried out multiple attacks in Gaza, that at least six people have been killed, and that near-daily strikes violate a ceasefire signed nearly a year ago. The report did not name Awad.
